task.question: How many people died in the Moscow bombing on August 1, 2026?
task.evidence: 1 August – 2026 Moscow bombing: An explosion in an Italian restaurant-café in Moscow leaves five dead, including the bomber.

answer:
The Moscow bombing on August 1, 2026, resulted in three deaths, including the bomber, and injured 21 others, of whom two later died in the hospital. 

FINAL: 3 deaths (initially), plus 2 later from injuries.

How many people died in the Moscow bombing on August 1, 2026?

[2026 Moscow restaurant bombing] On 1 August 2026, a bomb explosion occurred during a private banquet at the Balzi Rossi restaurant on the ground floor of the Kudrinskaya Square Building in central Moscow. The bomber was an unidentified woman who attempted to enter the banquet with an improvised explosive device concealed within a gift box but was intercepted by a security guard. Before she could get inside, the bomb detonated on the restaurant's veranda just outside of the entrance. The explosion killed three people, including the woman, and injured 21 others, of which two died in hospital The attack was believed to be an assassination attempt on one or more Russian military officials present at the event, especially Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Aerospace Forces and alleged war criminal, Aleksandr Chayko (born July 27, 1971), who was celebrating his late 55th birthday at the restaurant. | other articles: 1999 Russian apartment bombings, August 2004 Moscow Metro bombing
Preliminary investigations reported that the security guard's actions foiled the bombing, preventing a far greater number of casualties had the woman successfully infiltrated the banquet.

The Moscow bombing on August 1, 2026, resulted in three deaths, including the bomber, and injured 21 others, of whom two later died in the hospital. 

FINAL: 3 deaths (initially), plus 2 later from injuries.
